briefing: US-Turkey F-35 MOU signed 18:00 Day 9, Poland B9 Working Group approves Zapad surge protocol, Russia announces Zapad-2026 (Sept 1-10, 85K troops), China de-escalates to 85 sorties/day, oil $87.
narrative: The Day 10 F-35 deadline loomed over Round 15 like a guillotine blade. At 18:00 Day 9—six hours before Erdoğan's ultimatum—US Vice President Vance and Turkish VP Yilmaz signed the F-35 Memorandum of Understanding in a hastily arranged White House ceremony. The terms: first 4 F-35As delivered Q3 2027 (July-September window), remaining 36 by end of 2030, conditional on Turkish battalion commitment through 30 September 2026 (covering Zapad period). Turkey not only accepted but sweetened the deal: within 30 days, Ankara would deploy an Altay tank battalion (150 modern MBTs) to Lithuania, commit to a 5-year EFP 2.0 rotational framework, and sign the London Communiqué without reservation. The 50 withdrawn troops quietly returned to Vilnius overnight. Crisis averted.
